_comment: Advisories the production audit gate accepts (scripts/check-audit.mjs). Each needs the reason it cannot be reached and the ticket that removes it. The gate fails when an entry stops appearing, so remove it then.

accepted.reason: Memory exhaustion needs a large array checked against an array schema with no length cap. No zod check of request input has an array schema (validateRequestData's schemas, CreateTokenBodySchema, PaymentLinkBodySchema), and the deployed app caps JSON bodies at express's default 100 KB (api/index.ts). Fixed only in zod 4.6.6; 3.x has no patch.

Below the gate's threshold; listed so it is not forgotten. Only @deepgram/sdk uses it, to merge its own fetch options with the SDK's request options, which our server code builds; no caller input reaches it. No patched release exists.
accepted.removedBy: a deepmerge release that fixes it, or @deepgram/sdk dropping it
